title: Steelers use seldom-used UFA tender on Rodgers

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Steelers use seldom-used UFA tender on Rodgers
sources.description: The Steelers placed the seldom-used UFA tender on quarterback Aaron Rodgers on Tuesday, which preserves Pittsburgh's right to receive a compensatory draft pick in the event that Rodgers signs with another team before July 22.
